project.name: VexelRay GUI :: Draw
project.description: A picture: an ordered list of marks in one local pixel frame, and the two things that can consume it — the engine's Canvas, and an SVG writer. One authored drawing, two targets, and the alphabet is bounded by what the Canvas can actually draw, so neither target is a degraded version of the other. Below -core rather than beside it: a picture knows nothing of nodes, layout, themes or the bus. See docs/drawing.md.
